messages:
mina: 03:01 UTC nightly cron job `models-refresh` failed — job exited 1. Noticed multiple 503s from S3 in the pod logs. Anyone on it? :eyes:

craig: I saw the alert. Can you paste the last ~50 lines of the pod log? Might be throttling / transient network.

mina: pasted logs:
```
2026-11-02T03:00:15Z ERROR downloader.go:87 GetObject 503 "SlowDown" x-amz-retry-after: 2
2026-11-02T03:00:16Z WARN fetcher.go:142 attempt 2/3
2026-11-02T03:00:18Z ERROR main.go:210 job failed after 3 attempts
```

sara: Looks like S3 rate limiting. We recently onboarded the new model catalog and the job now pulls ~1.2k model manifests — spikes traffic. :grimacing:

ryan: Ops, could be bursting from all clusters. @ops-bot any recent S3 throttling incidents/quotas?

ops-bot: Noted — no org-wide S3 incident open. Throttling observed on bucket redwood-models-prod-us-east-1 between 02:58-03:05 UTC, small spikes. Suggest adding retries with backoff.

craig: Quick mitigation: rerun the cron job with reduced concurrency and enable client-side retries. Mina, can you trigger a one-off with env OVERRIDE_CONCURRENCY=4 and RETRY_MAX=6?

mina: Running now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra create job --from=cronjob/models-refresh models-refresh-rerun-1792345678
kubectl -n infra set env job/models-refresh-rerun-1792345678 OVERRIDE_CONCURRENCY=4 RETRY_MAX=6
``` 

deploy-bot: Job models-refresh-rerun-1792345678 created by mina

ci-bot: rerun started — attaching logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/models-refresh-rerun-1792345678

mina: second run completed successfully, no 503s. Summary: pulled 1,183 manifests, runtime 10m, no failures. :thumbsup:

craig: Nice. We'll still need a code fix. I opened PR #4822 to add exponential backoff + jitter and bump retries for the S3 client. Leaving a note to chunk model list pull to 200 per worker.

sara: Also file a follow-up to add a dashboard for model-sync error rate and token bucket metric for S3 calls. I'll create the ticket.

ryan: I'll schedule a short post-mortem doc in the eng-ml wiki and assign owners to the follow-ups.

mina: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for now. If it flaps tomorrow we'll assume infra rate limit and escalate. :white_check_mark:
